title: Why Your Gym Wants You To Skip
topic: Why gyms count on you not showing up
mechanism: Gyms sell flat monthly fees to overconfident members who go far less than planned and cancel late, so most dues pay for visits that never happen.

beats.hook: January first: you sign up at seventy dollars a month
beats.story: You go three days in a row; your neighbour laughs from his couch
beats.twist: By March the bag is in the car, and the salesman rings the AUTOPAY bell on his desk
beats.mechanism: Calendar board PLANNED 9 / WENT 4, price tags $17 PER VISIT vs $10 PASS, piggy bank $600, calendar pages flipping after LAST VISIT, member counter 7,000 at the turnstile
beats.ending: The neighbour signs up; the bell is already ringing

seed.what: The AUTOPAY desk bell on the salesman's front desk

locations.set: Room night + car trunk + gym bag

characters.look: red tank top, cap, whistle lanyard

gags.what: You fall off the end of the treadmill
The car trunk pops open and the dusty gym bag thumps out
The piggy bank cracks open, empty
